description: This file defines the RequestHandler class responsible for managing storage operations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage for applications, as well as managing storage info and size calculations. The class also maintains internal state such as storage info maps, mutexes for thread safety, and references to external storage objects.
external_methods: Core::hresult CreateStorage(const std::string&, const uint32_t&, std::string&, std::string&)
Core::hresult GetStorage(const std::string&, const int32_t&, const int32_t&, std::string&, uint32_t&, uint32_t&)
